title: albizia pruinosa
intro: Albizia pruinosa, commonly known as the Indian siris tree, is a deciduous tree native to the tropical regions of Asia, particularly in India and Sri Lanka. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing fever, treating gastrointestinal issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Albizia pruinosa include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and cytotoxic activities, making the plant a valuable resource in the development of new medicines.
